series_short_description: Growing up in Virginia Beach as autistic fraternal twins, Katie and Nathaniel ("Nate") Prairie build an unbreakable sibling sanctuary to weather school heartbreaks, family storms, and the Blizzard of '96.
series_description: Katie & Nathaniel follows the childhood and teenage years of autistic fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel ("Nate") Prairie (born April 8, 1985) in Virginia Beach. From secret afternoon cartoon passwords, summer camp at Virginia Dominion University alongside Michael and Rachel Ragsdale, and holiday sofa-bed sanctuaries to the historic Blizzard of '96, middle-school Spirit Week, and their sixteen-year-old summer sanctuary watching Journey to the Sunlit Valley, Nate and Katie discover that while the outside world—and their mother's alcoholism—can be loud and unforgiving, twin brothers and sisters never leave each other behind.

parts.part_title: Cartoons Are for Life: The Secret Password & The Afternoon Sanctuary
parts.excerpt: At nine years old in Virginia Beach, fraternal twins Nathaniel and Katie Prairie use their secret knock and password—'Cartoons are for life'—to seal their afternoon bedroom sanctuary.
parts.image_alt: Inside Nathaniel's deep-blue bedroom in Virginia Beach in 1994, nine-year-old fraternal twins Nathaniel and Katie Prairie with matching light platinum-blonde hair sit side by side on the carpeted floor in front of a 1990s CRT television and cable converter box, holding hands and smiling as their favorite afternoon cartoon theme plays

images.alt: Inside Nathaniel's deep-blue bedroom in Virginia Beach in 1994, nine-year-old fraternal twins Nathaniel and Katie Prairie with matching light platinum-blonde hair sit side by side on the carpeted floor in front of a 1990s CRT television and cable converter box, holding hands and smiling as their favorite afternoon cartoon theme plays

chapters.chap_title: Summer Camp at Virginia Dominion University

parts.part_title: The Parallel Pair: Dominion Mall & The VDU Fieldhouse
parts.excerpt: During a two-week summer camp session at Virginia Dominion University in July 1994, nine-year-old autistic twins Nathaniel and Katie Prairie and siblings Michael and Rachel Ragsdale refuse every counselor attempt to split them into boy-and-girl pairs.
parts.image_alt: Inside the 1994 Virginia Dominion University computer lab, nine-year-old platinum-blonde fraternal twins Nathaniel and Katie Prairie share a desktop computer at Terminal 5 right beside nine-year-old Michael Ragsdale and seven-year-old Rachel Ragsdale at Terminal 4, all wearing royal-blue VDU Summer Camp t-shirts

images.alt: Inside the 1994 Virginia Dominion University computer lab, nine-year-old platinum-blonde fraternal twins Nathaniel and Katie Prairie share a desktop computer at Terminal 5 right beside nine-year-old Michael Ragsdale and seven-year-old Rachel Ragsdale at Terminal 4, all wearing royal-blue VDU Summer Camp t-shirts

parts.part_title: The Newport News ARTS Train & The Downstairs Sofa Bed
parts.excerpt: When Grandma, Aunt Elizabeth, and cousin Chelsea arrive on the evening ARTS train in Newport News for Christmas, nine-year-old twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie claim the downstairs sofa bed as their holiday sanctuary.
parts.image_alt: On a December 1994 evening in the downstairs living room in Virginia Beach, nine-year-old fraternal twins Nathaniel and Katie Prairie in modest long-sleeved winter flannel pajamas sit side by side under a warm quilt on the unfolded living-room sofa bed holding hands while their cousin Chelsea in flannel pajamas sits near the foot of the bed

images.alt: On a December 1994 evening in the downstairs living room in Virginia Beach, nine-year-old fraternal twins Nathaniel and Katie Prairie in modest long-sleeved winter flannel pajamas sit side by side under a warm quilt on the unfolded living-room sofa bed holding hands while their cousin Chelsea in flannel pajamas sits near the foot of the bed

parts.part_title: Snow Day in Virginia Beach & The Backyard Promise
parts.excerpt: As the historic Blizzard of January 1996 blankets Virginia Beach and their parents argue inside the house, Katie pulls Nathaniel into a fierce bear hug in the snow-covered backyard and promises she will never leave him.
parts.image_alt: During the Blizzard of January 1996 in their snow-covered Virginia Beach backyard in front of a white wooden picket fence at dusk, Katie Prairie in a blue winter jacket and dark jeans and her twin brother Nathaniel Prairie in a black winter jacket and blue jeans hold each other in a tight bear hug in the falling snow

images.alt: During the Blizzard of January 1996 in their snow-covered Virginia Beach backyard in front of a white wooden picket fence at dusk, Katie Prairie in a blue winter jacket and dark jeans and her twin brother Nathaniel Prairie in a black winter jacket and blue jeans hold each other in a tight bear hug in the falling snow

parts.part_title: No More Fighting & The Dinner Dance Promise
parts.excerpt: When middle-school heartbreak leaves Katie sobbing in her bedroom, Nathaniel steps in to comfort her, ending their childhood squabbles forever and promising to take her to the school Dinner Dance.
parts.image_alt: Inside Katie's magenta-purple bedroom with a framed blue morpho butterfly artwork on the wall, early-teen Katie Prairie in a dark navy short-sleeve t-shirt and white jeans and her twin brother Nathaniel Prairie in a maroon short-sleeve t-shirt and blue jeans stand facing each other holding both hands as Nathaniel comforts her

images.alt: Inside Katie's magenta-purple bedroom with a framed blue morpho butterfly artwork on the wall, early-teen Katie Prairie in a dark navy short-sleeve t-shirt and white jeans and her twin brother Nathaniel Prairie in a maroon short-sleeve t-shirt and blue jeans stand facing each other holding both hands as Nathaniel comforts her

parts.part_title: Twin Brothers Always Stay: Spirit Week & The Living Room Sofa
parts.excerpt: Waking up side by side the next morning, Nathaniel promises Katie that 'boyfriends come and go, but Twin Brothers always stay'—before the two of them dress alike for Spirit Week Twins' Day and curl up together on the living room sofa.
parts.image_alt: Early-teen fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie with matching light platinum-blonde hair, wearing identical maroon short-sleeve t-shirts and blue jeans for Spirit Week Twins' Day, sit snuggled close together on their tan-brown living room sofa with Katie's arm draped around Nathaniel's shoulders

images.alt: Early-teen fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie with matching light platinum-blonde hair, wearing identical maroon short-sleeve t-shirts and blue jeans for Spirit Week Twins' Day, sit snuggled close together on their tan-brown living room sofa with Katie's arm draped around Nathaniel's shoulders

parts.part_title: Summer Sanctuary: Hearthstone Pizza, The Sunlit Valley, & Katie's Room
parts.excerpt: At sixteen years old on their first full day of summer with the house to themselves before Summer School begins, Nathaniel and Katie Prairie share matching bowls of cereal, curl up on the sofa over Journey to the Sunlit Valley and its Hearthstone Pizza birthday commercial, and end the evening side by side in Katie's bedroom beneath the blue butterfly.
parts.image_alt: Inside sixteen-year-old Katie Prairie's magenta-purple bedroom beneath the framed blue morpho butterfly artwork on the wall, fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie sit propped up against the pillows on her green-and-gold bedspread in modest t-shirts and pajama pants, holding hands with Katie's arm draped warmly around Nathaniel's shoulders

parts.part_title: Part 1: Part 1: The I-95 Haul, The Quantum Basic Library Book, & Ditching Captain Barnaby
parts.location: Port Canaveral, FL & Aboard the M/S Sunward Tropics
parts.excerpt: Forced onto a seven-day Caribbean cruise out of Florida at the end of August 2001, sixteen-year-old Nathaniel and Katie Prairie bring their father's Virginia Beach Public Library Quantum Basic textbook aboard and get rescued by Dad from an elementary-school character breakfast.
parts.image_alt: Inside the sunlit Deck 8 CyberCafé and Library aboard the M/S Sunward Tropics in August 2001, sixteen-year-old fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie sit side by side at a desktop computer terminal with their father David Prairie's public library Quantum Basic textbook open between them while David smiles proudly beside them

images.alt: Inside the sunlit Deck 8 CyberCafé and Library aboard the M/S Sunward Tropics in August 2001, sixteen-year-old fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie sit side by side at a desktop computer terminal with their father David Prairie's public library Quantum Basic textbook open between them while David smiles proudly beside them

parts.part_title: Part 2: Part 2: The Nassau Pier, Guest Services, & The Last Straw
parts.location: Nassau, Bahamas & Aboard the M/S Sunward Tropics
parts.excerpt: After watching Nathaniel and Katie's legs buckle on the long concrete pier in Nassau and hearing their honest feelings on deck, David Prairie cuts off Brenda's alcohol tab at the Purser's Desk and stands between his sixteen-year-old twins and their mother when she chooses the bottle over her family.
parts.image_alt: Inside a quiet passenger corridor alcove aboard the M/S Sunward Tropics cruise ship in August 2001, sixteen-year-old fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie sit side by side holding hands and comforting their father David Prairie, who holds their three plastic shipboard keycards with soda-package stickers

images.alt: Inside a quiet passenger corridor alcove aboard the M/S Sunward Tropics cruise ship in August 2001, sixteen-year-old fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie sit side by side holding hands and comforting their father David Prairie, who holds their three plastic shipboard keycards with soda-package stickers

parts.part_title: Part 3: Part 3: Stateroom 6004, The Loaner Wheelchairs, & Pizza for Three on the Aft Deck
parts.location: Aboard the M/S Sunward Tropics, Caribbean Sea
parts.excerpt: Refusing to let Brenda near his twins again, David has the Chief Purser relocate him, Nathaniel, and Katie to a confidential wheelchair-accessible stateroom with two loaner manual wheelchairs—while Brenda lands in the ship's brig and gets banned from the cruise line.
parts.image_alt: At golden-hour sunset on the open wooden aft deck of the M/S Sunward Tropics cruise ship overlooking the Caribbean wake, sixteen-year-old fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie sit side by side in ship-provided folding manual wheelchairs holding hands at a round deck table with their father David Prairie, sharing hot pizza and tall soda tumblers

parts.part_title: Part 4: Part 4: Back on Dry Land & The Twelve-Hour Drive Up I-95
parts.location: Port Canaveral, FL, Interstate 95 North (GA & NC), & Virginia Beach, VA
parts.excerpt: On the twelve-hour drive from Port Canaveral back to Virginia Beach, David helps Nathaniel and Katie through every highway stop without the ship's wheelchairs while Brenda's attempts to bargain only harden his resolve to hire a divorce lawyer.
parts.image_alt: Sitting side by side on the gray cloth rear bench seat of their family sedan along Interstate 95 North in August 2001, sixteen-year-old fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie hold hands with their father's mylar-wrapped Quantum Basic library textbook open across their laps and a white paper drive-thru lunch bag beside them

images.alt: Sitting side by side on the gray cloth rear bench seat of their family sedan along Interstate 95 North in August 2001, sixteen-year-old fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie hold hands with their father's mylar-wrapped Quantum Basic library textbook open across their laps and a white paper drive-thru lunch bag beside them

parts.part_title: Part 5: Part 5: Monday Morning in Virginia Beach — The Divorce Lawyer, The PCP, & Borrowed Time
parts.excerpt: Keeping his vow on Monday morning in Virginia Beach, David retains a divorce attorney off Independence Boulevard and takes Nathaniel and Katie to their primary care physician—who discovers that their weakening arms and legs mean they are walking on borrowed time.
parts.image_alt: Inside a Virginia Beach primary care physician's exam room in late August 2001, sixteen-year-old fraternal twins Katie and Nathaniel Prairie sit side by side on the exam bench holding hands while their father David Prairie stands beside them and the family doctor tests Nathaniel's arm and grip strength
